_help: Shape Challenge content. 'shapes' is the order players see. 'sides' is 0 for a circle, otherwise the number of sides of a regular polygon (3 = triangle, 4 = square, 5 = pentagon ...). Timer, pass mark and difficulty live in config.json.
title: Shape Challenge
rules: Draw each shape with one finger, in one continuous stroke.
Lift your finger to see your accuracy.
Score {threshold}% or more to complete a shape.
Complete {target} shapes before the {time} timer runs out to win a surprise gift!
winMessage: Show this screen to collect your surprise gift!
timeUpMessage: So close! Take a breath and try again.
